component.name: YourTube
component.summary: Watch YouTube with your history kept on your computer

description.p: YourTube is a YouTube app that keeps your watch history and recommendations on your own computer, with no account. Every recommendation says why it is there.

ul.li: Recommendations made on your computer from what you search and watch
SponsorBlock, downloads, chapters, comments, profiles and incognito
Optional routing through Tor, with a separate circuit per kind of request
A web version for the other devices in your home
Import from Google Takeout, NewPipe and FreeTube; export everything
